## Why

11A's acceptance must be *verified at the highest layer actually
reached* — never a fabricated live pass. P34.46's L2/L3 legs are queued
(the earliest slot opens 2026-10-14T14:00Z), so today the honest result
is the machinery landed + the leg queued with its exact re-run prompt +
a suppressed record as the evidence — not a sweep that ran.

## What ships

- **`sig-ops acceptance-sweep` (`ops/src/ops/acceptance.py`, wired in
  `cli.py`).** A `sig.acceptance-gate/1` gate over recorded inputs (the
  RETURN PASS map + a recorded `now`, never the wall clock): exit 42
  queued while `live:P34.46` fails or the window floor hasn't passed;
  `p34_46_l3_soak` and an absent handle list are *advisories* that scope
  legs (exit-5 skipped; RI-01 "not checked", never passed). On `run`,
  the read-only sweep crawls the five surfaces — site (sitemap +
  `--site-url`), API routes, ranged-GET tile bytes, a downloaded
  `sig-public` listing, and the repo tip via the P34.18 count-only
  crawler — and counts (a) every entry of the gitignored handle list
  (**counts only**; values never printed or recorded) and (b) the L3
  §4.5/C6 not-claimable and status words outside the disclosed-context
  list (TS-10). The F-02 absence probe reuses the cadence `http-absent`
  targets; `--reads-file` carries the caller-captured
  scheduler/billing/cert reads; `exit_item_5_soak` stays skipped until
  the L3 soak is recorded. Verdicts: a `skipped`/`partial` leg caps
  `overall` at `partial`; `pass` means every leg ran clean.
- **`docs/build/tools/acceptance_report.py`** (`generate`/`check`) →
  `docs/build/reports/acceptance/11A.md`: every 11A row's
  highest-reached layer from its head evidence (the "owed to D-…" text
  never lifts the layer), the eight exit items verdicted honestly
  (queued while their legs are queued), and the OM-19 due-evaluation
  (due / conditional / indeterminate / awaiting-go / waiting) over the
  RETURN PASS map. `check` fails if the note reports a row above its
  evidence.
- **`docs/build/tools/gate_packet.py`** (`draft`/`check`) →
  `docs/build/readouts/GATE-G4.md`: row 260's six-part packet —
  budget, publication, rights (ING-GO-A/B + flip lists), the 11B OM-20
  list, the Class R standing-go renewal (quoted verbatim, sha256
  `e4e24975b854…`), status — agent-drafted inside a sha256-labelled
  block, every line carrying its non-action `Default:`, `batch` marked
  only where `continue` may answer, the carried OP-24/backstop
  questions. It signs nothing; the operator hash-confirms before use.
- **The committed suppressed record**
  `docs/build/reports/acceptance/11A-probe-run.json` — the refusal is
  the evidence.
- **Tests**: `tests/ops/test_acceptance.py` (23 — gate refusal shapes,
  count-only scans, disclosed contexts, skipped-leg honesty, the CLI
  exit-42 path), `test_acceptance_report.py` (8 — the owed-layer trap,
  leg states, no fabricated live verdict), `test_gate_packet.py` (6 —
  PENDING, sha256 re-computes, Defaults on every line, tamper fails).
